name: The Works 2025
description: Odyssey Esports' premiere summer spectacle event for 3 years running feat. Ultimate, Melee, Rivals, SF6 & more!

content.text: The Works 2025 is the Odyssey’s third premier FGC summer regional since inception in 2023 focused around Smash, Rivals, and Street Fighter 6.

The event takes place in beautiful downtown Fort Wayne, Indiana at the newly built Electric Works campus – formerly an old GE plant. The campus features lots of different businesses and great food options with a new but rustic vibe!

The Works 2025 is held in the GE Gym with 10,000 sq. ft for some great Midwest gaming. The event theme is based around the Electric Works campus and the lightbulb with great aesthetic designing and merchandise available before the event.

The first Smash 2023 was a culmination of the Odyssey Esports movement, making Fort Wayne the hub for esports in the Midwest and breaking the record for the largest Smash Ultimate event since COVID in Indiana. The Works honors this special event in Indiana FGC history (while remaining Big N compliant :p).

This year looks to shatter records and be more exciting than ever with top players for Smash Ultimate, Melee, & Rivals alongside the great talent from all over the Midwest! Odyssey Esports’ last trademark event, Afterburner 2025 in January, brought over 450 players for the LAN and this event looks to follow its heat and excitement in the heart of downtown Fort Wayne!

Attendees will be released in May; previous The Works events have brought 200 players respectively, while Afterburner 2025 brought 450. We are expecting somewhere in the middle for this summer spectacle.

The Works will primarily focus on the open competitive brackets for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Melee, Rivals 2, and Street Fighter 6 alongside an open Ultimate ladder and other exciting treats for our attendees!
Our events also tend to feature free snacks, deodorant, and hot hands which, while simple, have been a standout to attendees!
Streams will be on CollisionSeriesTV channels and Odyssey Esports channels
All ages event; venue fees range from $35–60 depending on when players register.
We also have a special $30 youth venue fee for any players 18 and under or still in high school, helping younger players attend our events!
We are very invested in the growth and improvement of our next generation of players alongside the high school and collegiate esports scenes and love the opportunities they provide for students.

Top quality production through the Collision and Odyssey team members, top quality commentary teams managed by KevinWithAK, best graphics in the business by Fungi, and a high-quality GRASSROOTS-focused Midwest team to bring it all together.
Will you make it Work this summer?

TheGathering.gg is back with our first Timeless $1K! That's $1,000 cash in this FREE event!

This funding is provided in partnership with Nouns, a different kind of currency committed to the support of esports, cardgames, artistic endeavors, and other general unsupported spaces for doing cool things. You can check them out at

Swiss rounds will be based on attendance. If more 16-31 players participate, the final two rounds will be a cut to top 4. If more than 32 players participate, there will be a cut to top 8 instead. The round structure will be locked in based on the attendance at the signup deadline.
The Format is MTG Arena Timeless, best of 3 matches using the MTG Arena in-game timer.
Players will use the Direct Challenge system of MTGArena to pair with each opponent. To challenge a player using this system:
Get their MTG Arena Screen name from the MTG Melee round pairings
Click the crossed swords in the top right corner of the MTG Arena Client
Use the Arrows to select: (Limited Tournament Match)(Deck Type:60 Card)(Format:Best of Three)(Coin Flip)(Timers On)

All players are required to submit a Timeless legal decklist 1 Hour before the event start time. If there is no decklist or communication from a player by the start time, that player will be dropped from the tournament.

Unintentional draws aren't allowed for this event, but intentional draws are possible with the agreement of both players. All normal MTG rules must be followed whenever possible, and there's a 0 tolerance policy for bribes, coercion, and paid agreements.

Decklists will be open, and any player can safely stream their match over discord for a chance to appear on the official broadcasts. We politely request that undefeated to stream in Discord. Do note all Top 8 Matches will be required to be streamed.
All players must be in The Gathering Discord for communication purposes

In the event a player isn't in a match with their opponent within 5 minutes of the start time of each round, a match can't be completed, or a player disconnects, contact a Gathering staff member to assist. In the event of a disconnect mid-match, potential penalties include a game or match loss.
Please contact any of TheGathering.gg staff members over discord with any questions or concerns.
Registration closes 30 minutes before the event
Each round will begin as soon as possible as each round finishes
The organizer has agreed to pay out prizes in 60 days or less.
$50 Held for Door Prizes or 9th place cutoff. Additional Door Prizes to be determined later and added based on attendance.
